notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Fungi and/or Beasts, and at least one additional creature except the Fungi or Beasts.
description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to gain life equal to the creature's toughness.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Fungus and Beast you control.
Repeat.
